    input_ptr, output_ptr, 
    input_stride_0, input_stride_1, input_stride_2,
    output_stride_0, output_stride_1,
    N, M,
    BLOCK_SIZE: tl.constexpr
):

    # We need to reduce over the M dimension (dim2)
    # So each block processes elements along the N dimension

    # Initialize accumulator with minimum value
    acc = tl.full([1], -65504.0, dtype=tl.float32)  # Minimum fp16 value
